L2_data_source_availability.notes: External CSVs from Tonak 1984 are digitized and cover the full book period. NIPA underlying source is cached. ES1001 specifically depends on Table II (Labor Share) which is NOT directly in the external CSV list (only Tables V/IX/X are present) but is recoverable from the HDARP chunk_11 extraction. Minor: a dedicated table_II_labor_share CSV would simplify L01 work.

evidence.ES1001_methodology_summary: Populated: 'Labor share of national income from Tonak (1984) Chapter IV Table II, 1952-1980, 28 annual observations. Defined as total labor income / personal income; serves as allocation key throughout the dissertation's net tax framework.'
evidence.ES1002_methodology_summary: Populated: 'Net tax rate on workers from Tonak (1984), 1952-1980 (28 years). Defined as taxes paid by workers minus benefits received, expressed as a proportion of employee compensation. Central empirical finding: workers are net taxpayers to the state throughout most of the period.'
evidence.formulas_present: ES1001: LS = Total Labor Income / Adjusted Personal Income (verbatim from chunk_11). ES1002: Net Tax = T_w - B; tax side via Group I/II classification with labor share allocation
evidence.construction_logic_documented: Both series have explicit Group I (100% to labor) and Group II (labor-share-weighted) classifications documented in research entries
evidence.worked_example_anchor: ES1001 has 1980 worked example (LS = 1483.370 / 2101.10 = 0.71); ES1002 has 1975 sign-flip qualitative anchor

L3_methodology_clarity.notes: Both research JSONs carry strong methodological documentation with verbatim formula quotes from the dissertation chapter.
